title: Prop-level risk tools for the crypto-firm portfolio (C* + premium carry + cascade, equal risk, 15% vol)
registered: 2026-10-15, before any Gen66 result was computed
replay: hourly path 2022-01..2026-09; challenge 1.0x, funded 0.6x; budget 5 challenges, 24 months, start every 5 days

tools.S50: intraday portfolio stop: when the day's loss on the hourly path reaches 50% of the firm's daily limit, flat for the rest of the UTC day (fill at that hour's close minus 10 bp)
tools.S75: same at 75% of the daily limit
tools.CUSH: cushion scaling (engine): size x clip((equity - floor) / max loss, 0.25, 1)

adopt: a tool is adopted only if it raises BOTH the mean net AND the unlucky-10% net at all four firms, and does not lower months with income by more than 3 points
